That's exactly what I was hoping for after last time. I picked the potato and Kyoto ones, added "Work" to both, and each kept what it already had — the potato still shows Recipes, Kyoto still shows Travel — and now both also carry Work. So a batch label adds to what's there rather than wiping it out, which is what I'd want.

And the continuation feels right too: after applying, both were still selected and it showed "2 selected" with the actions still there, so I could turn right around and do something else to the same batch — or hit "Done selecting" when I'm finished. That saves me from re-picking the same items just to make a second change. Good.

This covers the bulk-labeling I flagged earlier. What's next?
